item.title: Valve insists Steam Machine launch is still on track for this year
item.description: In February, Valve published its first hardware-related post since announcing the Steam Machine, Steam Frame, and Steam Controller 2 last year. The devices were supposed to launch before the end of March, but Valve extended the window to the first half of 2026.Read Entire Article

item.title: Uber expands female driver preferences in the US following safety concerns
item.description: Safety has been a key concern from the very beginning, especially since drivers are considered independent contractors rather than direct Uber employees. item.title: iPhone 17e reviews: two key upgrades refine Apple's entry-level formula
item.description: Early reviews of the iPhone 17e describe it as a solid refinement of Apple's $599 phone. Powered by the A19 chip with 256GB of storage, and the long-awaited addition of MagSafe. While some reviewers say it's still a bit pricey, most agree the 17e delivers a no-frills entry point into the Apple ecosystem.Read Entire Article

item.title: iPad Air M4 gets reviewed: More RAM, faster chip, same price
item.description: The iPad Air M4 may still be the best tablet for most people. For the same price as before, you get bumped to the M4 chip, 12GB of RAM, and Wi-Fi 7, making Apple's mid-range tablet faster and more capable.
